title: Terms of use
description: A clear guide to cabins, booking requests and cancellations.

ui.contactDescription: We can help explain the service and booking terms.

sections.title: Choosing a cabin
sections.text: A-FRAME helps you find cabins in Kyrgyzstan and submit booking requests. Real listings appear in the catalog after the owner is reviewed and an administrator publishes the property. Before requesting a stay, read the description, house rules, check-in and check-out times and the cabin's cancellation terms.

sections.title: Your account and property details
sections.text: Bookings and saved cabins require an account. Provide current guest contact details and keep your password private. Owners provide their cabin's description, prices, calendar and house rules, add photographs of their own property and submit the listing for review.

sections.title: Dates and confirmation
sections.text: Available nights and guest capacity are checked again when you submit a request. The price depends on your dates and the calendar's nightly prices. A real booking request starts as pending and is confirmed only when the host confirms it. Submitting a request alone does not confirm a stay.

sections.title: Cancelling a booking
sections.text: The cancellation deadline follows the cabin's rules; the exact date appears in the booking details. Guests can cancel a pending or confirmed request before that deadline if no payment has been received. Cancellation releases the dates. Paid bookings cannot be cancelled automatically, and the site does not process refunds.

sections.title: Demonstration listings and payments
sections.text: Cabins marked as demonstration properties and their photographs are illustrative, rather than verified rental offers. Creating a test request opens Finik Pay for a 5 KGS payment. A test request and its payment do not include a real stay or host confirmation. Real bookings also support Finik Pay with a fixed charge of 5 KGS. Payment takes place on the Finik page and is confirmed by the payment service; creating a request does not charge you automatically.
